title: Typed research-only prescribed-groundwater-level state machine inside the SWAP profile
activation_dependency: GC-LOW01-A must pass before LOW01-B execution is treated as qualified evidence.
source_state_machine: Start NN=0 and increment while z(NN+1)>gwlinp.
For inside-profile mode 1, fllowgwl remains false.
The active Richards residual is solved only on nodes 1:NN.
After convergence, theta(NN+1:numnod) is set saturated and h(NN+1:numnod) is reconstructed from the vertical flux chain.
qbot is diagnosed from the complete vertical flux chain, not prescribed.

research_surface.approach: Call the existing HeadCalc explicit-state route directly with bottom_mode=1 from a test-only bridge, bypassing the production adapter's intentional mode-1 admission guard.
research_surface.control: prescribed groundwater-level coordinate in native SWAP cm, kept distinct from mode-5 lower-face pressure head.
research_surface.immutable_origin: Every fixed-gwl trial is rebuilt from the same frozen base state; no accepted mode-1 state is fed into another trial.

gates: For each fixed groundwater level, the research-only HeadCalc trial converges without dt reduction or alternative solver.
Observed fllowgwl is false and active NN equals the preregistered 1/2/3 value.
Nodes NN+1:numnod end saturated at cofgen(2,i) to 1e-12 water-content units.
Observed lower-gradient denominator equals z(NN)-gwlinp and the source-bound Jacobian branch is the inside-profile Kmean/(z(NN)-gwlinp) branch.
qbot is finite and is reconstructed as an output; no prescribed qbot is supplied.
Complete-profile storage change plus integrated boundary/process fluxes closes within 1e-10 cm for each case.
Repeated execution of the same fixed-gwl case from the frozen origin is bitwise identical in candidate pressure head, water content, qbot, gwl, gwlinp and fllowgwl.
forbidden: do not change src/adapter/mod_reference_richards_legacy_binding.f90 to admit mode 1
do not expose mode 1 through the production FMR serialized backend
do not alias gwlinp to the existing groundwater-coupling mode-5 bottom_head contract
do not use LOW01-B as HLINK04 production evidence
do not include near-node or profile-bottom branch switching in LOW01-B; that belongs to LOW01-C
next_if_pass: Execute LOW01-C branch-boundary sweep around internal nodes and the profile bottom.
Execute LOW01-D transactional replay/rejection with explicit mode-1 branch state.
Only after A/B/D pass and C is characterized may HLINK04 real-SWAP trials be activated.
